# Play Therapy Supply

> Play Therapy Supply offers a comprehensive catalog of therapeutic toys, games, sensory tools, and supplies designed for counselors, therapists, and child life specialists.

The site specializes in evidence-based play therapy materials including sand tray therapy supplies, games for coping skills and social-emotional learning, puppets, art therapy tools, and sensory fidgets. It serves mental health professionals, educators, and specialists working with diverse populations including children with autism.

## Key Topics

- Play Therapy
- Sensory Toys
- Fidget Toys
- Sand Tray Therapy
- Therapy Games
- Coping Skills
- Social-Emotional Learning

- Stress Relief

## Core Product Categories

- [Play Therapy Supply: Therapeutic Toys • Games • Sandplay](https://www.playtherapysupply.com): Homepage showcasing therapeutic toys, games, sand tray supplies, and expert recommendations
- [Therapy Games & Counseling Games](https://www.playtherapysupply.com/games): Product catalog of therapy games for counseling, coping skills, and self-esteem
- [Play Therapy Toys](https://www.playtherapysupply.com/toys): Play therapy toys including fidgets, dolls, role play, and dollhouses
- [Sandtray Therapy Supplies & Miniatures](https://www.playtherapysupply.com/sand-tray-therapy): Sand tray therapy supplies including miniatures, trays, sand, and starter kits
- [Sensory Toys & Fidgets](https://www.playtherapysupply.com/sensory): Sensory toys, fidgets, and calming tools for diverse populations and classrooms
- [Puppets for Play Therapy](https://www.playtherapysupply.com/puppets): Puppet catalog including hand puppets, finger puppets, and diverse family sets

## Specialized Therapy Resources

- [Best Play Therapy & Counseling Books](https://www.playtherapysupply.com/books): Play therapy and counseling books covering CBT, EMDR, DBT, and therapeutic activities
- [Art Therapy Supplies & Activities](https://www.playtherapysupply.com/art-therapy): Art therapy supplies and activities including paints, clay, books, and creative tools
- [Social Emotional Learning Activities & Resources](https://www.playtherapysupply.com/social-emotional-learning): SEL activities, games, and resources for building empathy and emotional regulation
- [Portable Play Therapy Kits](https://www.playtherapysupply.com/portable-play): Portable therapy kits, sand trays, games, and compact tools for mobile therapists
- [Autism Toys & Sensory Tools](https://www.playtherapysupply.com/autism): Toys, sensory tools, and resources for children with autism and social skills
- [Child Life Specialist Toys](https://www.playtherapysupply.com/child-life-specialist): Coping tools and toys for child life specialists in hospital settings

## Playroom & Environment

- [Playroom - Fixtures, Decor, and Organization](https://www.playtherapysupply.com/playroom): Playroom fixtures, decor, storage, and organization items for therapy spaces
